children: Stock-specific action remained in focus on Dalal Street on September 3, with investors reacting to corporate developments.

Power Grid share price gain after company received a Letter of Intent (LoI) for an inter-state transmission system project for the evacuation of power from Rajasthan REZ Phase-IV on a build, own, operate and transfer (BOOT) basis, at quoted annual transmission charges of Rs 3,244.33 crore. The project comprises the establishment of 6,000 MW ±800 kV HVDC terminals at Barmer-II in Rajasthan and South Kalamb substation in Maharashtra, along with the augmentation of the South Kalamb substation.

Shares of Hexaware Technologies fell 3% after company announced the appointment of Vivek Jetley as CEO-designate. He will join the company and assume the role of CEO on October 28, 2026. Srikrishna Ramakarthikeyan will step down as CEO and as a member of the Board of Directors, effective October 28. He will continue with the company as a senior adviser to ensure a smooth leadership transition.

Housing & Urban Development Corporation (HUDCO) share price gained 3% after the company signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) with the Government of Bihar to provide financial assistance of up to Rs 25,000 crore over a period of five years for the development of industrial infrastructure, including land acquisition for projects.
Among sectors, Nifty IT declined 1%, while energy, media, metal, PSU Bank, Private Bank and realty indices gained 0.5-2%, indicating selective buying across cyclical sectors.
The broader market traded higher, with the Nifty Midcap index rising 0.3% and the Smallcap index adding 1%.
However, market breadth on the BSE remained weak, with 2,304 shares advancing, 943 declining and 177 unchanged, suggesting a mixed trend beneath the headline gains.

title: Price Action: HUDCO rises 3% on Rs 25,000 crore Bihar MoU; Hexaware falls 3% after CEO exit
